target_customer: SaaS product teams that want customer-facing charts, dashboards and exports inside their app
problem: Building embedded analytics and export features in-house is slow. DataShare offers a hosted warehouse and embeddable components implementable in under 20 lines of code.
business_model: B2B SaaS, likely usage or seat based (pricing not found)

founders.name: Brian Brunner
founders.background_notes: About four years at Stripe, including a year and a half as engineering manager for the Data Pipeline and Sigma teams, per the YC page. Education not listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Multi-tenant warehouse, connectors to 20 plus sources and embeddable charting is substantial but standard engineering for a solo founder with Stripe data infrastructure experience.

defensibility.rationale: Embedded components create some switching cost once shipped in a customer product, but several established embedded analytics vendors offered similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: One vendor blog says Omni acquired Explo in October 2025, showing consolidation in the category. No acquisition of DataShare found.

market_need_then: SaaS companies commonly need customer-facing reporting and export features. Evidence of specific demand for DataShare in 2023 was not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses datashare.co, not the .com. The domain did not resolve from this environment at time of research.

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and plain per YC description

brand_strength.rationale: The name DataShare is shared by several unrelated projects including a university repository and an Explo feature, so search confusion is likely. No brand press or community found.

outcome_analysis: DataShare is listed as active with a team of one. No press, funding announcement or customer evidence was found beyond the YC listing. Aggregators mention a pre-seed from YC, but the status and trajectory of the company are not public in sources I could verify.
notes: Aggregators (extruct, vcbacked) report about 500K dollars of pre-seed from YC dated 2023, unverified and not recorded as a round. A directory profile claims a Series A announced in February 2026; only a single directory source, unverified and not recorded. Company website datashare.co failed DNS resolution during fetch, so site status unknown. Competition list empty: only 2025 to 2026 comparison pages were found, none dated near the S23 batch. Completeness pass: a $500K YC pre-seed in 2023 is recorded from Extruct and VCBacked (databases; VCBacked says Sep 2023, CB says 2023-01-01, so only the year is kept). The 2026 Series A claim stays unrecorded.
